text: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund is Riyad Bank's largest shareholder with a 21.75% stake, two PIF representatives sit on the bank's board, and the state pension body GOSI holds a further 10.39%.
short: PIF is Riyad Bank's largest shareholder (21.75%) with two board seats; GOSI holds 10.39%.
